title: Baseline file
description: A baseline is a YAML file with name, date, the commit of every repository involved and ID plus version of every element in the selection (D-039, SR-050). ReqSeq writes the file; a person commits it with Git (D-036, SR-050 AK4). No reason or approval field (D-006, SR-050 AK3). The metamodel of the baseline is given by the commit of the metamodel repository (D-021).

selection.description: How the elements were selected, for information. The element list is authoritative.

elements.description: Sorted by id; one flow mapping per line.
